items.title: Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence for a surjection of presheaves of sets
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs a spectral sequence computing the cohomology of K from the cohomology of the fibre products K'_p, for a map of presheaves of sets K' -> K whose sheafification is surjective, with E_1^{p,q} = H^q(K'_p, F) and convergence to H^{p+q}(K, F) (statement lines 2072-2080). The proof builds the simplicial object from the fibre products (proof lines 2082-2088), shows that it resolves K because the map becomes surjective after sheafification, and identifies the E_1 page of the resulting spectral sequence (proof lines 2088-2094). The non-formal content is the use of sheafification to obtain the resolution. The claim is H2: one construction plus one page identification.
